dalam Jadual daripada menjalani tempoh perkhidmatan sebagaimana yang dikehendaki

di bawah seksyen 41 Akta.

MEDICAL ACT 1971

MEDICAL (EXEMPTION OF PUBLIC SERVICE PERIOD) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 42(1) of the Medical Act 1971

[Act 50], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Medical (Exemption of Public Service Period)

Order 2014.

Exemption

2. The Minister grants a complete exemption to the persons named in the Schedule

from undergoing the period of service as required under section 41 of the Act.
